newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PRIVATISATION OF ESTONIAN TELEKOM TO BE APPROVED.
newsitem.headline: PRIVATISATION OF ESTONIAN TELEKOM TO BE APPROVED.

text.p: Estonia's transport ministry is expected to approve the privatisation programme of Estonian Telekom this week, Aripaev newspaper said on Tuesday.
According to the programme, the state plans to sell the stakes held by Eestonian Telekom in smaller communication companies this year.
The newspaper named pager service provider Eesti Kaugotsing and Telemedia Eesti, which publishes telephone directories.
One third of Estonian Telekom will be sold on an international stock exchange such as the London bourse in 1998, the newspaper said.
Only majority shares in Estonian Telephone and Estonian Mobile Telephone, the two strategic companies, will be maintained, Transport Minister Raivo Vare was quoted as saying.
